Nice to meet you! I saw your adorable stylized illustrations on Skeb and fell in love at first sight, which is why I'm reaching out with this request! This time, I'd like to request an illustration of my original character. He's a male fallen angel spider with eagle wings, characterized by droopy eyes. His rounded eyebrows and tear-shaped beauty marks are actually multiple eyes.
I'd be thrilled to see him in various expressions in your style, Akakado Bomb-san...! Thank you in advance! https://u.pcloud.link/publink/show?code=kZHFxl5Z06cHCpQ6QFzV2Br1UNcBB8sYcWey

Nice to meet you! I'm Rurii Umino, a VTuber working independently. After seeing Akakado Bomb-sama's vivid, unique, and adorable illustrations, I was so inspired that I decided to request an illustration from you! 【Request Details】 Illustration of Rurii Umino (VTuber/Original Character)

▼Reference Materials ・Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17nyS1aVqaFfnUhk6VLRRSTcpPsIG2uRD?usp=sharing ・X: https://twitter.com/uminorully ・YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@uminorully

【Usage】 ・Various SNS posts ・YouTube activities (monetized) ・Merchandise sales 【Composition】 I'd like to leave everything up to Akakaku Bomb! Since it will be used for YouTube thumbnails, a composition where her face is clearly visible would be appreciated. It would be a huge help if you could draw her hair and head so the tips aren't cut off.

【Delivery Format】 If possible, delivery as layered PSD data (or transparent PNG data) would be greatly appreciated. We apologize for the inconvenience during your busy schedule and sincerely appreciate your consideration.

Hello! This is my second request! I'm Miyako Karasuma, active on IRIAM! The previous illustration was absolutely wonderful...! Thank you so much for the truly adorable artwork! I'm reaching out because I'd love to request your services again!

This time, I'd like to request an SD version based on the reference image below. Here's the reference image: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GkNmBOS2wkG9G4YfH6_5N_tZG9C5DxEc/view?usp=drivesdk


Since it's a songstress outfit for a singing stream, I'd like her to be singing and hyping up the audience again! Please make her look cool, sexy, and a little devilish rather than just cute! This is the first time she's showing her tail in her transformed form, so please don't forget to include the tail!🙇 Also, the cat-form face you drew for the mini-character last time was so adorable, I'd be thrilled if you could draw a mini-cat character for me this time too!


【Usage】 For use on IRIAM, X, YouTube (thumbnails, icons, etc.) Commercial use for panel openings, rewards, merchandise, etc. Thank you very much for your consideration! https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GkNmBOS2wkG9G4YfH6_5N_tZG9C5DxEc/view?usp=drivesdk

Dear Akakado Bomb, Thank you for your continued support. I'm Tanana Piatto, a personal VTuber active on Twitch and YouTube. Apologies for the consecutive requests. I love your illustrations and wanted to see a different design, so I'm sending another request! ・I work as a Mama VTuber alongside my Persian cat, [Pepe-sama]. I play games with all my might and spread energy to everyone!
I'm a drum-breaking-level VTuber. I absolutely love anything exciting and fun! I adore FPS shootouts and am a total muscle-brain! Energetic, a joker, dad jokes—I love them all! My character features are a tear mole, buck teeth, heart-shaped highlights in my eyes, and braided bangs.

・Costumes & Hairstyle For hairstyles, please use reference materials and keep only the color and braided bangs feature—any style is welcome! For costumes and poses, I'd like to leave everything completely up to Bomb-san! ・Usage For streaming-related use (affiliate links enabled), SNS use, stamps, thumbnails, merchandise, and other commercial uses. When making merchandise, I'd like to introduce Bomb-san via RTs and such!
Currently, I'm considering making stickers, so a design that looks great as a sticker would be wonderful! I'd also like a version with a transparent background. I hope we have the chance to work together... ✨ https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fQ2KY6pc0N2M4lkJihVHVJWGk9saiMVd?usp=sharing Thank you in advance! ✨

Mr. Akakado Bomb, nice to meet you. I'm Tanana Piatto, a personal VTuber active on Twitch and YouTube. I fell in love at first sight with your unique illustrations and color palette while searching online, and I've had the pleasure of viewing your past works! Every single illustration is truly wonderful, and I couldn't stop feeling excited while looking at them! I'd love for you to draw my character too, so I'm submitting this request!

・I'm a Mama VTuber who streams alongside my Persian cat, [Pepe-sama]. I play games with all my might and spread energy to everyone! I'm a VTuber who shatters eardrums. I absolutely love anything exciting and fun! I adore FPS shootouts and am a total muscle-brain! I'm energetic, a bit of a joker, and love dad jokes!

My character features include a tear tattoo, a double tooth, heart-shaped highlights in my eyes, and braided bangs. ・Outfit & Hairstyle I'd be thrilled if you could choose one of the four hairstyles from the reference materials! For clothing, I'd love something street-style that looks like it would suit skateboarding! Accessories like caps are also very welcome, so please feel free to draw them however you like!



・Usage: For streaming-related use (affiliate links enabled), SNS use, stamps, thumbnails, merchandise, and other commercial uses. If used for merchandise, I'd love to feature you via RTs or similar! Currently thinking of stickers, so a design that looks great on them would be awesome! Please also provide a transparent background version. Hoping for a good connection... ✨


https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fQ2KY6pc0N2M4lkJihVHVJWGk9saiMVd?usp=sharing Thank you in advance! ✨

こんばんは、AltoVoidと申します。
以前イラストをSkebで依頼した際に納品して下さった作品は今も大切に使用させていただいております！
今回は私が新衣装を出すことになったため、新衣装の自分を描いていただけないかと思いリクエストさせていただきました。

◆イラストについて
私、AltoVoidの新衣装verを描いていただきたいです。
外見については、資料URLとして添付したアドレスをご参照ください。

三面図も添付していますが、タトゥーや異形の手など細部がわかりづらい箇所は適度に簡略化・想像で描いてもらっても構いません。
ポージングは黒魔術っぽさが感じられるものだと嬉しいです。（ふわっとしていてすみません）
差分をつけていただける場合、反転目差分があると嬉しいです。

◆使用目的
SNS上での告知・宣伝画像への使用
配信サイト（収益化あり）およびSNSでのアイコンとしての使用
配信時に使用するサムネイルへの使用
配信中に画面内に表示させるイラスト・Twitchスタンプとしての使用
グッズへの使用

◆キャラクターについて
今回は悪魔が7割、人間が3割のバランスで構成されている悪魔（バフォメット）をイメージした衣装です。
外見は以前よりも人外っぽさを重視していますが、中身はそこまで変わっていません。
反転目＋顔の模様がついた時はより悪魔要素が濃く出ているという設定です。
額・ピアス・胸元・髪飾りの目玉はそれぞれ個別に動きます。（必ずしも本体の顔と同じ方を見ている必要はありません）
この衣装は主にホラゲー（サイコホラーや洋ゲー）、クトゥルフ神話TRPGなどをしている時に使うビジュというイメージです。

◆その他
・可能でしたら、人物のみの透過データを頂けると嬉しいです。
・金額が足りない場合は再送していただければ対応いたします。難しい場合はキャンセルして下さって構いません。

何卒、ご検討のほどよろしくお願いします。

AltoVoid
XおよびTwitchID：@AltoVoid111

Dear Akakaku Bomb, Nice to meet you. I'm Sun La Mall, a VTuber active on YouTube. After seeing the illustrations you accepted via Skeb, I'd very much like you to create artwork for my VTuber activities and am submitting this request.

【Usage Purposes】 ① Posting and use on various SNS (e.g., for "Good Morning VTuber" posts, weekly schedule posts, etc. / Use for icons, headers, etc.) ② Posting on my website (lit.link) ③ Use for stream thumbnails, waiting screens, and end cards (on monetized channels)
④ Use of the illustration during streams and in videos. ⑤ Use as benefits for paid fan club members, including fan club thumbnails, etc. ⑥ Commercial use for digital goods/physical goods, etc. ※ For some uses, this may include placing text over the image, cropping, or light editing to blend the image (e.g., adding a white border, applying a faint overlay) without distorting the original form. ※ When using the illustration, we will always clearly credit the creator.
